final: SELECT g.link_to_event, g.avg_spent, g.avg_rem, g.avg_rem - t.avg_rem AS diff FROM (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_rem FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event) g JOIN (SELECT AVG(remaining) AS avg_rem FROM budget) t ON t.avg_rem IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
